mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 AM, here is today's balanced dish on the weather, which features overcast skies and a comfortable temperature of 68 degrees near Harriet Park.

The City of Verona is hosting an I Voted sticker contest for K-12 students with submissions open until July 22, and residents are also encouraged to inspect their mailboxes for winter readiness following official Public Works guidelines.
We have a busy schedule ahead with live music at Bailey's Run and Wisconsin Brewing Company today, followed by the Dane County Farmer's Market and music at Paddy Mac's tomorrow.
Reviewing our weekly police report, a notable incident occurred on July 13 involving a 36-year-old man who was arrested for an O-W-I after his vehicle became immobilized on a large rock.

Today's flavor of the day is the decadent Chocolate Volcano. Please note that the store is currently closed, but they will be opening their doors at 10 AM to serve you. If you are looking for something different tomorrow, they will be featuring Caramel Fudge Cookie Dough.
